subject: Parking Department and Enforcement Update
overview: The City Council Committee of the Whole met with Parking Director Faye Morrison to review parking department operations, meter upgrades, and widespread permitting data errors. The council approved a motion requesting a legal review of the city's contract with former vendor Park Medford.

items.title: Parking Department Overview and Working Conditions
items.summary: Parking Director Faye Morrison presented an operational update detailing department staffing, appeal resolution times, and outstanding facility and safety issues in the parking office.

items.title: Medford Square Meter Replacement and Lobby Payment Kiosk
items.summary: Morrison detailed the ongoing replacement of street kiosks with single-space contactless meters in Medford Square and the procurement of an exterior multilingual payment and document kiosk.

items.title: Public Comment and Resident Permitting Errors
items.summary: Residents and councilors criticized recent mass-ticketing incidents and proposed permit expansions, while Morrison attributed street-level ticketing errors to inaccurate legacy data inherited from the prior vendor.

items.title: Parking Office Renovations and RMV Holds
items.summary: Chief of Staff Nina Nazarian addressed delays in reconfiguring the parking director's office, while resident testimony highlighted ongoing difficulties clearing resolved parking tickets with the Registry of Motor Vehicles.

items.title: Legal Review of Park Medford Contract
items.summary: Approved a motion requesting that the administration and city solicitor review the contract with former parking vendor Park Medford and Reef Republic to determine if grounds exist for legal action to recover costs.
